lead: This week: River Festival ends Sunday. Chinatown lanterns Saturday 6pm. Common Rare at Suntec. Then F1 in October.

items.title: Singapore River Festival (last days)
items.blurb: 10th edition, The Quay Collective. Boat Quay entertainment, Clarke expression, Robertson wellness. Free along the river; some ticketed boat rides. Ends Sunday.

items.title: Chinatown Mid-Autumn — Light a Lantern
items.blurb: No giant lanterns on Eu Tong Sen this year. Community lanterns 11 Sep–4 Oct. Saturday 19 Sep 6pm: procession, mooncake and tea, riddles in four languages. Lion dance and wushu 2pm. Free.

items.title: Common Rare Market
items.blurb: 200 independent brands, 12.30pm–9pm. Tickets from S$7; under-12s free. The indoor weekend if the weather does what it does.

items.title: Gardens by the Bay Mid-Autumn
items.blurb: Lanterns without the office-pantry small talk. Outdoor gardens are still free; go after 7pm when the heat drops.

items.title: Lights by the Lake
items.blurb: West-side Mid-Autumn food fair, 6.30–11pm. Official start 19 Sep; some stalls from the 18th. Lakeside MRT. Heartland, not the bay.

items.title: Music Matters Live
items.blurb: 21st edition, free. 40 acts from 15 countries across Fountain Square and Swee Lee. Four nights before F1 swallows the river.

items.title: Mid-Autumn Festival
items.venue: Chinatown, Chinese Garden, every office pantry
items.blurb: Mooncakes, lanterns, a public-holiday-adjacent Friday. Eat the snow-skin. Take the kids out once.

items.title: Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix
items.blurb: First Sprint weekend here. The Killers Saturday, Lana Del Rey Sunday. Road closures 7–13 Oct. Last trains late from City Hall.

items.title: Marina Centre road closures
items.blurb: LTA: roads shut 12.01am 7 Oct, fully open 5.30am 13 Oct. Work from home. Do not drive to the bay.

items.title: Deepavali
items.blurb: The lights go up weeks before. Go in the evening. Eat. It is a public holiday.

items.title: Parkrun (every Saturday)
items.venue: East Coast, West Coast and others
items.blurb: Free 5 km. The most reliable way to see the same people every week without joining a club with a joining fee.

items.title: Pulau Ubin weekends
items.blurb: Bumboats when full. Last boat back is not a suggestion. Bicycle at the jetty.

items.title: Esplanade free stages
items.blurb: Concourse and outdoor performances that are actually good. Aircon adjacent. Check the month’s grid.

items.title: Museum late nights
items.blurb: When the Civic District stays open after dinner. The cheapest date that still feels like the city.
